vcl.name: Verb after an elided pronoun (j', m', t', s', n', c')

raw.name: The scanned text itself (no rule gives this)

fin.name: Finite verb before an inverted subject

transforms.name: elided word
transforms.description: An elided article, pronoun, de, ne or que before a word, removed: l'homme → homme, d'eau → eau, j'ai → ai, qu'il → il, n'est → est.

transforms.name: elided form
transforms.description: The word an apostrophe follows, read as its elided and full forms: l → l', le, la; qu → qu', que.

transforms.name: reflexive imperative
transforms.description: An affirmative imperative with a reflexive pronoun after it, read as the pronominal verb: lève-toi → se lève, assieds-toi → s'assieds, va-t'en → s'en va.

transforms.name: imperative + pronoun
transforms.description: An affirmative imperative with the pronouns attached to it after a hyphen, removed: donne-moi → donne, dis-le-lui → dis, vas-y → vas.

transforms.name: -nous, -vous
transforms.description: An imperative with nous or vous attached to it, or a verb with nous or vous as its inverted subject, the pronoun removed: asseyez-vous → asseyez, pouvez-vous → pouvez.

transforms.name: inverted subject
transforms.description: A verb with its subject pronoun after it, as in questions and after quotations, removed: parle-t-il → parle, dit-elle → dit, est-ce → est, puis-je → puis.

transforms.name: -ci, -là
transforms.description: A noun with the demonstrative -ci or -là after it, removed: ce jour-là → jour, cette fois-ci → fois.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of a noun or adjective: livres → livre, chevaux → cheval, travaux → travail, jeux → jeu, vœux → vœu, yeux → œil.

transforms.name: present (je)
transforms.description: Present indicative, je: suis (être), ai (avoir), vais (aller).

transforms.name: present (tu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, tu: parles (parler), es (être), as (avoir).

transforms.name: present (il)
transforms.description: Present indicative, il: finit (finir), prend (prendre), vient (venir).

transforms.name: present (je, tu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, je and tu: finis (finir), prends (prendre), viens (venir).

transforms.name: present (je, il)
transforms.description: Present indicative, je and il: parle (parler).

transforms.name: present (nous)
transforms.description: Present indicative, nous: parlons (parler), finissons (finir), prenons (prendre).

transforms.name: present (vous)
transforms.description: Present indicative, vous: parlez (parler), finissez (finir), prenez (prendre).

transforms.name: present (ils)
transforms.description: Present indicative, ils: parlent (parler), finissent (finir), prennent (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect (il)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (imparfait), il: parlait (parler), finissait (finir), prenait (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect (je, tu)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (imparfait), je and tu: parlais (parler), finissais (finir), prenais (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect (nous)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (imparfait), nous: parlions (parler), finissions (finir), prenions (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect (vous)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (imparfait), vous: parliez (parler), finissiez (finir), preniez (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect (ils)
transforms.description: Imperfect indicative (imparfait), ils: parlaient (parler), finissaient (finir), prenaient (prendre).

transforms.name: simple past (je)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, je: parlai (parler), allai (aller).

transforms.name: simple past (tu)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, tu: parlas (parler), allas (aller).

transforms.name: simple past (il)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, il: parla (parler), finit (finir), prit (prendre).

transforms.name: simple past (je, tu)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, je and tu: finis (finir), pris (prendre), vins (venir).

transforms.name: simple past (nous)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, nous: parlâmes (parler), finîmes (finir), prîmes (prendre).

transforms.name: simple past (vous)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, vous: parlâtes (parler), finîtes (finir), prîtes (prendre).

transforms.name: simple past (ils)
transforms.description: Simple past (passé simple), the past tense of written narrative, ils: parlèrent (parler), finirent (finir), prirent (prendre).

transforms.name: future (je)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), je: parlerai (parler), finirai (finir), prendrai (prendre).

transforms.name: future (tu)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), tu: parleras (parler), finiras (finir), prendras (prendre).

transforms.name: future (il)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), il: parlera (parler), finira (finir), prendra (prendre).

transforms.name: future (nous)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), nous: parlerons (parler), finirons (finir), prendrons (prendre).

transforms.name: future (vous)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), vous: parlerez (parler), finirez (finir), prendrez (prendre).

transforms.name: future (ils)
transforms.description: Simple future (futur simple), ils: parleront (parler), finiront (finir), prendront (prendre).

transforms.name: conditional (il)
transforms.description: Present conditional, il: parlerait (parler), finirait (finir), prendrait (prendre).

transforms.name: conditional (je, tu)
transforms.description: Present conditional, je and tu: parlerais (parler), finirais (finir), prendrais (prendre).

transforms.name: conditional (nous)
transforms.description: Present conditional, nous: parlerions (parler), finirions (finir), prendrions (prendre).

transforms.name: conditional (vous)
transforms.description: Present conditional, vous: parleriez (parler), finiriez (finir), prendriez (prendre).

transforms.name: conditional (ils)
transforms.description: Present conditional, ils: parleraient (parler), finiraient (finir), prendraient (prendre).

transforms.name: subjunctive (je)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, je: aie (avoir).

transforms.name: subjunctive (tu)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, tu: parles (parler), finisses (finir), prennes (prendre).

transforms.name: subjunctive (il)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, il: soit (être), ait (avoir), faille (falloir).

transforms.name: subjunctive (je, tu)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, je and tu: sois (être).

transforms.name: subjunctive (je, il)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, je and il: parle (parler), finisse (finir), prenne (prendre).

transforms.name: subjunctive (nous)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, nous: parlions (parler), finissions (finir), prenions (prendre).

transforms.name: subjunctive (vous)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, vous: parliez (parler), finissiez (finir), preniez (prendre).

transforms.name: subjunctive (ils)
transforms.description: Present subjunctive, ils: parlent (parler), finissent (finir), prennent (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (je)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, je: parlasse (parler), finisse (finir), prisse (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (tu)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, tu: parlasses (parler), finisses (finir), prisses (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (il)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, il: parlât (parler), finît (finir), prît (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (nous)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, nous: parlassions (parler), finissions (finir), prissions (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (vous)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, vous: parlassiez (parler), finissiez (finir), prissiez (prendre).

transforms.name: imperfect subjunctive (ils)
transforms.description: Imperfect subjunctive (imparfait du subjonctif), mostly in literary writing, ils: parlassent (parler), finissent (finir), prissent (prendre).

transforms.name: imperative (tu)
transforms.description: Imperative, tu: parle (parler), parles (parler), finis (finir).

transforms.name: imperative (nous)
transforms.description: Imperative, nous: parlons (parler), finissons (finir), prenons (prendre).

transforms.name: imperative (vous)
transforms.description: Imperative, vous: parlez (parler), finissez (finir), prenez (prendre).

transforms.name: present participle
transforms.description: Present participle and gerund (-ant): parlant (parler), finissant (finir), prenant (prendre).

transforms.name: past participle
transforms.description: Past participle, masculine singular: parlé (parler), fini (finir), pris (prendre).

transforms.name: past participle (feminine)
transforms.description: Past participle, feminine singular: parlée (parler), finie (finir), prise (prendre).

transforms.name: past participle (plural)
transforms.description: Past participle, masculine plural: parlés (parler), finis (finir), pris (prendre).

transforms.name: past participle (feminine plural)
transforms.description: Past participle, feminine plural: parlées (parler), finies (finir), prises (prendre).

transforms.name: pronominal
transforms.description: A verb with a reflexive pronoun of its person before it, looked up with se: je me lève → se lever, tu t'appelles → s'appeler, je m'en vais → s'en aller.

transforms.name: infinitive
transforms.description: An infinitive after an elided pronoun, read as the verb: m'aider → aider, t'appeler → appeler, s'asseoir → asseoir.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine of an adjective, and its superlative in -issime: grande → grand, première → premier, heureuse → heureux, active → actif, belle → beau, blanche → blanc, richissime → riche.

transforms.name: feminine noun
transforms.description: Feminine of a noun for a person, by the endings such nouns take: joueuse → joueur, actrice → acteur, pécheresse → pécheur, jardinière → jardinier, musicienne → musicien, citoyenne → citoyen, veuve → veuf.

transforms.name: adverb in -ment
transforms.description: An adverb in -ment, read as its adjective: vraiment → vrai, lentement → lente, couramment → courant, évidemment → évident, précisément → précise.

transforms.name: determiner form
transforms.description: A form of a determiner, pronoun or numeral: toutes → tout, quelques → quelque, cette → ce, mes → mon, laquelle → lequel, millions → million.
